description: Repository class for managing DataSet entities, including CRUD operations and complex queries based on footprints, SDGs, calls, and channels within the Goteo project.

classes.name: DataSetRepository
classes.description: Repository class for DataSet entity, providing data access methods including retrieval, counting, listing, and persistence.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a DataSet by its ID.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of DataSet records.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of DataSet objects with pagination.

methods.name: getListByFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves DataSets associated with specific footprints.

methods.name: getLastByFootprintAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent DataSet for given footprints and type.

methods.name: getListBySDGs
methods.description: Retrieves DataSets associated with specific SDGs.

methods.name: getLastBySDGsAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the latest DataSet for given SDGs and type.

methods.name: getListByFootprintAndSDGs
methods.description: Retrieves DataSets filtered by footprints and SDGs with pagination.

methods.name: getListByCall
methods.description: Retrieves DataSets associated with specific calls.

methods.name: getLastByCallAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the latest DataSet for given calls and type.

methods.name: getListByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves DataSets associated with specific channels.

methods.name: getLastByChannelAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the latest DataSet for given channels and type.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Creates or updates a DataSet record.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new DataSet record into the database.
